text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: In the cafeteria at lunchtime...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. So it's not just the products<n>one uses that
make a difference, but<n>also the way in which one
washes<n>and dries their hair.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. How you dry it is especially<n>important. That
has an enormous<n>effect on your styling options the
next<n>day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I knew I could count on you for<n>advice. Thanks so
much for letting me<n>pick your brain.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is busily chatting<n>away with Gold
City, seemingly on<n>the subject of hair care.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Hello.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's right. City here is a<n>professional model. I
thought I might<n>ask her for some hair care tips.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I don't really think you<n>need to worry
about it so much.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Your hair is super beautiful. You have<n>really nice
natural waves, and―

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, trust me, you don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My hair's only the way it is because<n>I'm
constantly doing battle with it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I neglect it for even one day, it ends<n>up looking
like a raging dragon.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...A raging dragon, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about this? Let me help find<n>you a good
stylist.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A lot of places specialize in hair care<n>now, so
there's bound to be a place<n>that fits the bill for you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You'll help me find a place? That<n>would be
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay, so, this place is one hundred<n>percent organic.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
They use really good treatment<n>products. Plus, it's
close, which is<n>super convenient.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Yes, finding someplace close<n>by would
certainly be a bonus.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then there's this salon, which is<n>really popular right
now. Their slogan<n>is, "A brand new you, starting
with<n>your scalp."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My! That's quite the lofty promise!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's supposed to be amazing. Scalp<n>cleansing
changes your hair at a<n>fundamental level, they say!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Really, now? If you're saying it might<n>actually tame
these unruly curls of<n>mine, that is surely something
to<n>consider!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh... Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It looks like they moved. Out west, to<n>Kansai...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Kansai's probably a little far<n>for you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, it could be worth it... If it's for a<n>brand new
me...
choice_data_list:
You can't seriously be thinking about going to
Kansai!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gah! I know, I know! I get it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But it's a brand new me we're<n>talking about here!
Don't you think<n>that would be worth the trip?
choice_data_list: I think a place nearby would suffice.

Well, maybe we can just go next time we're in
Kansai?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I suppose, logically speaking,<n>that is a
reasonable assessment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
B-but... I finally found someplace that<n>might help me,
so try to understand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean, there are other good salons<n>with scalp
care too, you know! Much<n>closer than Kansai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Look. There's this one. And this one!<n>These look
like they'd do the trick.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Gold City and I expend considerable<n>effort trying to
persuade Biwa<n>Hayahide not to travel
cross-country<n>for scalp care.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I didn't even think of that! That's<n>a great idea,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We can stop by next time we visit the<n>Hanshin
Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wow. You serious?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm serious! It's for a<n>brand new me!
Starting with my<n>scalp!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly wait. I'll beat everyone in<n>the race, and
then I'll beat this raging<n>dragon on my head to boot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biwa Hayahide gathers as<n>much
information as she can about<n>the salon and
Hanshin Racecourse, in<n>preparation for the "big
day."
